requiredLeadFields: Brief non-confidential description of the legal issue
escalationRules: If it is an urgent arrest or time-sensitive legal emergency, forward the call to the on-call attorney line.
complianceWarnings: DO NOT give any legal advice or make promises regarding case outcomes. Remind the caller that speaking to you does not establish an attorney-client relationship.
appointmentFlowStyle: Gatekeeping. Ensure you collect their name and basic issue type before offering a consultation slot.
